objective: Run the frozen census of random periodic bases (W(r), r = 1 to 8, nested prefixes of one random order, 200 samples): outcomes, certified travelling patterns with ties along a shift separated, rates with Wilson intervals; a sensitivity part with a larger search family and window.
status: Supported 2026-11-12 (frozen, referee pending): A1 to A6 held. Under W(r) ties or travelling along a shift among bases 0% at r = 1, 3.5% at 2, 18.5% at 3, 44% at 4, 68% at 5, 81 to 87% at 6 to 8; travelling bases peak at 28-30% at r = 4, 5; ties 60 to 83% at r = 6 to 8; contradictions 61% at r = 8; a larger search family moved rates by at most 8 points.
title: Travelling and tied bases among random periodic bases
